Vaishnavi Qureshi
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
vaishnavi.qureshi169@example.com | +91 9567422267

Result-driven Talent Acquisition Specialist with a strong technical foundation and hands-on experience managing full-cycle recruitment for product and engineering teams. Skilled in leveraging sourcing tools and HR systems to reduce time-to-hire and improve candidate experience while coordinating onboarding and payroll activities. Collaborative team player who applies Agile practices to hiring processes and maintains clear documentation in Confluence.

Experience

Talent Acquisition Specialist (Remote)

- Administered candidate data and offer workflows in Workday, reducing offer processing time by 20% through optimized templates and automated status updates.
- Coordinated Payroll-related onboarding steps and documentation for 75 new hires across India, ensuring accurate input to payroll systems and 100% compliance with joining paperwork.
- Partnered with hiring managers in Agile sprints to prioritize hiring needs, maintain clear role backlogs in Confluence, and deliver weekly hiring progress reports tracked with Git-based trackers.

Candidate Experience Improvements — Freshworks
- Designed and implemented a structured feedback loop using Confluence pages and templates to collect candidate feedback post-interview; feedback response rate improved from 30% to 62% within three months.
